title: Murder of Shraddha Walkar
narrative: FIR — Murder of Shraddha Walkar, Mehrauli, New Delhi. On 18 May 2022, Shraddha Walkar, aged 27, was strangled to death by her live-in partner Aaftab Amin Poonawalla at their rented house in Mehrauli following an argument. Poonawalla then dismembered the body into several pieces, stored the remains in a refrigerator, and disposed of them over the following days in the Chhatarpur forest area. The crime came to light months later after Shraddha's father lodged a missing-person complaint. Poonawalla was arrested by Delhi Police on 12 November 2022 and charged with murder.
